name: ambiguity
description: Tests whether the policy retrieves the right sense of an ambiguous term given context.

seed_memories.core: Physical power is measured in watts. Power equals work over time.
Physical power can also be expressed as force times velocity.
Political power is the ability to influence others' behavior through authority.
Political power often concentrates in institutions and can be measured by decision-making control.
Memory in computers refers to RAM and storage devices.
Human memory is reconstructive and changes each time it is recalled.
State machines are used in computer science to model sequential logic.
A nation-state exercises sovereignty over its territory and citizens.
